name: W Muscat
positioning: A W beach hotel on Muscat's Shatti Al Qurum beachfront, with Omani nomadic-inspired rooms, a rooftop infinity pool and the Royal Opera House a stroll away
best_for: Beach-lovers who want sea-view rooms and pools within reach of the city
Culture-seekers who want to walk to the Royal Opera House Muscat

facts.text: The Penthouse II has a DJ space and a bathtub lit by constellation lighting.
Fabulous Rooms have private balconies overlooking the Gulf of Oman.
An AWAY Spa treatment room has a geometric skylight meant to feel like being deep underwater.
AWAY Spa has a Vichy shower.
The hotel has two outdoor pools.
The tennis courts are lit for night play.
The gym has Technogym equipment and sea views.
Zuma Muscat serves izakaya-inspired Japanese dining with Gulf of Oman views.

highlights.text: The hotel is on the Shatti Al Qurum beachfront in Muscat.
The rooftop infinity pool has panoramic views of the Shatti Al Qurum coastline.
In the Wonderful Room, the ceiling echoes a desert tent and the minibar and closet are built from stacked luggage trunks.
The Royal Opera House Muscat is a stroll away over a walking bridge.
The WET Deck bar is inspired by the Bimmah Sinkhole, with floor-to-ceiling mirrors that reflect the ocean.

considerations.text: The hotel strongly suggests reserving pool loungers and cabanas in advance.
The rooftop infinity pool sits within Siddharta Lounge by Buddha-Bar.
WhataHotel notes the contemporary style may not suit travelers with traditional tastes.
